headline: Debian and Ubuntu APT flaw allows root code execution via MitM; NIKKE launcher hack and mSecure reset warnings stay active

bullets.text: New, high: The Hacker News reports a flaw in APT on Debian and Ubuntu lets man-in-the-middle attackers swap verified packages and run code as root.
Still active, critical: BleepingComputer reports the NIKKE PC game launcher was hacked to spread remote access and data-stealing malware.

Still active, mSecure, 3 outlets: BleepingComputer reports a hack of the mSecure password manager has prompted password reset warnings. The Register says mSecure told users to change their passwords and would not say why.
Still active, critical: The Hacker News reports APT29-linked hackers hijacked a web analytics script to deliver iOS and Android exploits. Help Net Security describes the exploits as n-day.
Still active, cPGuard, 4 outlets: SecurityWeek reports malicious updates served in an OpsShield supply chain attack. BleepingComputer says the hijacked autoupdate deployed a backdoor and stole data.

Still active, WordPress Core, 3 outlets: BleepingComputer reports CISA flags a WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited. CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-119977, a race condition added 2026-11-03, with a federal due date of 2026-11-06.

actions: Check Debian and Ubuntu advisories for the APT flaw and apply fixed packages on your hosts and images as soon as they are available.
If the NIKKE PC launcher is on any machine you manage, check it for remote access and data-stealing malware and rotate credentials used on it.
If you or your staff use mSecure, change the master password and rotate the credentials stored in it, starting with the most sensitive.
Update managed iOS and Android devices to current releases, and apply Google's patch for CVE-2026-58868 as it reaches your fleet.
If you run cPGuard, check servers for the backdoor reported by BleepingComputer and treat data on affected hosts as exposed.
Patch WordPress Core for CVE-2026-119977 (KEV due 2026-11-06) and Ivanti Connect Secure for CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527.
